instruction:
I want VLC to automatically detect and load subtitle files when I open a video. Please enable the subtitle autodetect feature in VLC settings.
How can I turn on automatic subtitle detection?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling VLC's subtitle autodetection (sub-autodetect-file=1). Created custom metric function check_vlc_subtitle_autodetect__d8ae66c5. Expected value is 1 (enabled).

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement to enable VLC subtitle autodetection
Getter 'get_vlc_config' appropriately reads the VLC configuration file (vlcrc) where subtitle settings are stored
Metric function correctly checks for 'sub-autodetect-file=' setting in the config file
Expected value of 1 is semantically correct for enabling the subtitle autodetect feature
Metric correctly handles the 'expected' parameter - directly accesses 'expected["expected_subtitle_autodetect"]' without incorrectly trying to access 'expected["rules"]'
Metric handles default case appropriately - assumes value '1' if setting is not explicitly in config file (which matches VLC's default behavior)
Postconfig appropriately kills and relaunches VLC to ensure configuration changes are written to disk before verification
Complete coverage - single requirement (enable subtitle autodetect) is fully verified
